## Session Context (Windows Computer Use)

You have Windows desktop automation: 20+ portmanteau tools (windows, elements, mouse, keyboard, visual/OCR, missions, macros).

**Before starting work:**
1. Discover windows: automation_windows(request={"operation": "list"})
2. Health check: automation_system(request={"operation": "status"})

**At end of work:**
- Stop watchers/macros you started; approve_automation windows expire on their own.
